source.check: returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 6 January 1933) Citation restored to the original page (6 Nov 2026): the 5 Nov re-citation pointed to an unrelated item; the original page OCR is poor.

note: Annual thirds, polled 16 January 1933, one councillor retiring in each of the five wards (Castle, Central, Glen, Scrabo, Victoria). Four wards were uncontested; the only contest was in Scrabo Ward, where Isaac Baxter defeated the retiring member T. A. Brett. Returned unopposed.
